name: fluid-resuscitation
title: Closed-loop fluid resuscitation (BioGears)
question: Does a MAP-targeted IV infusion change the course of a right-leg hemorrhage in BioGears, and does it matter whether the fluid is saline or O-negative blood?
hypothesis: A closed loop that infuses once MAP falls below 90 mmHg ends the run with more blood volume and a higher MAP than the untreated bleed, with saline and blood alike over 10 minutes.
objective: Run the untreated bleed (biogears_hemorrhage, RightLeg, 200 mL/min initial rate, StandardMale@0s, 600 s) against biogears_resuscitation with Saline and with Blood_ONegative (MapFluidController: target 90 mmHg, gain 25 mL/min per mmHg, cap 250 mL/min).

readouts.name: irreversible-state
readouts.description: BioGears reported an irreversible state; the engine is no longer advanced.

readouts.name: iv-rate
readouts.description: Infusion rate commanded by the MAP controller (0 in the untreated arm).

units_and_time.note: BioGears' own clock; its internal solver step is 0.02 s.

expected_behavior.name: treatment-preserves-volume-and-pressure
expected_behavior.condition: both treated arms end with more blood volume and a higher MAP than the untreated arm

comparative_visualizations.name: map-by-arm
comparative_visualizations.title: MAP-targeted infusion slows the fall in arterial pressure

comparative_visualizations.name: infusion-by-arm
comparative_visualizations.title: Infusion rate commanded by the MAP controller

controls.name: untreated
controls.hypothesis: Without treatment the bleed runs its course; this is the reference the treated arms must beat.
controls.expected: The rate-200 arm of hemorrhage-severity-sweep (pilot blood volume 4888 mL, MAP 87.9 mmHg at 10 min); no infusion.

controls.name: saline-map-90
controls.hypothesis: A closed loop that does engage should raise blood volume and MAP above the untreated reference, confirming the treatment readout responds.
controls.expected: Final blood volume and MAP above the untreated arm, with a non-zero commanded infusion.

robustness.note: BioGears is deterministic; the untreated arm repeats the severity sweep's rate-200 arm.

predictions: Pilot (2026-11-16, the three arms run directly for 600 s): untreated blood volume 4888 mL, MAP 87.93 mmHg; the controller first infuses at 427 s and gives 46 mL (saline) / 45 mL (blood); treated blood volume 4934 / 4933 mL, MAP 88.72 / 88.74 mmHg.
preregistered.thresholds_provenance: The untreated reference values come from that pilot; the treated criteria are directions only.
preregistered.pilot: All three arms were piloted, so the criteria are regression checks. The effect is small (about +46 mL and +0.8 mmHg) because MAP only drops below the 90 mmHg target late in the run.

falsifiability: Refuted if either treated arm ends with no more blood volume, or no higher MAP, than the untreated arm, or if the controller never infuses.
limitations: One bleed, one patient and one controller tuning; the target and gain are not swept.
10 minutes only; saline's dilution and blood's oxygen-carrying capacity are not read out (no hematocrit or oxygen readouts), so the compounds can only be compared on volume and pressure.
